meta.note: Signals and risk levels are computed on relative basis = (dated futures / perpetual futures - 1) * 100; the Si-12.26 quote is divided by 1000 first (points -> RUB). Fills and PnL use the dated futures leg only. M15 uses exact timestamp intersections; M1/M5/M10 synthesize the perpetual leg by as-of carry-forward of the latest perpetual M15 bar because perpetual M1/M5/M10 bars are absent; H1/H4 are resampled from aligned M15 basis. Volume filter uses dated futures volume. EUR/RUB 53 is excluded because it has no perpetual analogue. PnL is relative return on notional, not exchange point value.
